q: Just trust that everything is unfolding the way it is supposed to. Don't resist... Great things are waiting for you around the corner.
Life may be full of pain but that's not an excuse to give up.
The truly rich men are the ones who have health, loved ones and a work they love.
Never test the depth of river with both the feet.
Preoccupied with a single leaf you won't see the tree.
Saying nothing sometimes says the most.
We are always complaining that our days are few, and acting as though there would be no end of them.
Before enlightenment; chop wood, carry water. After enlightenment; chop wood, carry water.
Work for something because it is good, not just because it stands a chance to succeed.
Adversity is the tempering of one's mettle. Without it, we cannot know any true meaning in our accomplishments.
Storms don't last forever.
A real decision is measured by the fact that you've taken a new action. If there's no action, you haven't truly decided.
Mistakes are always forgivable, if one has the courage to admit them.
If you are ever the smartest person in the room, you are in the wrong room.
Everything begins with an idea.
Do not think you will necessarily be aware of your own enlightenment.
Every failure brings with it the seed of an equivalent success.
Wherever you are is the entry point.
All wealth is the product of labor.
The biggest mistake we could ever make in our lives is to think we work for anybody but ourselves.
It's what you do in the present that will redeem the past and thereby change the future.
Nothing endures but change.
Duty makes us do things well, but love makes us do them beautifully.
Make no small plans for they have no power to stir the soul.
Truth is such a rare thing, it is delighted to tell it.
The world would go on even without you. Don't take yourself so seriously.
Care about what other people think and you will always be their prisoner.
The pessimist sees difficulty in every opportunity. The optimist sees opportunity in every difficulty.
An inch of time is an inch of gold but you can't buy that inch of time with an inch of gold.
Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.
Everyone is a moon, and has a dark side which he never shows to anybody.
It is secondary whether we choose belief or defiance. What is precious is that we are always able to choose.
New opinions are always suspected, and usually opposed, without any other reason but because they are not common.
Love the life you live, live the life you love.
The most effective way to do it, is to do it.
People think about what they don't want and attract more of the same.
Adventure is worthwhile in itself.
Numbing the pain for a while will make it worse when you finally feel it.
Life does not get better by chance, it gets better by change.
The greatest value of a picture is when it forces us to notice what we never expected to see.
Dreams have only one owner at a time. That's why dreamers are lonely.
Thinking is the hardest work there is. That is why so few people engage in it.
Your mind will make you rich or poor, depending on the use you put to it.
Sorrow is how we learn to love.
The biggest room in the world is the room for improvement.
Today is plenty; right now is enough. Tomorrow will come in good time. Until it does, live the depth of now.
The final mystery is oneself.
Character is the result of two things: mental attitude and the way we spend our time.
All things come into being by conflict of opposites.
To escape from the world means that one's mind is not concerned with the opinions of the world.
